items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 27 September 2026 11:11pm
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Rain arriving early in the morning, turning heavy at times, before clearing early/ mid afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20, risk of 25-30.


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

S or SE 20-25, increasing 25-30, with gusts of 40-45 possibly 50 in places for a time in the afternoon, veering W by late afternoon. Then gradually decreasing 10-15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Yellow coastal overtopping warning from 1100 to 1400. Risk of localised surface water flooding due to heavy rain. Strong winds.


##Today##
